Track Catalog · 轨道总目录

posit::conf Workshop Catalog (2024–2026) · posit::conf 工作坊总目录

A curated, topic-organized map of official posit::conf / rstudio::conf workshop materials, covering three conference years. 2026 materials are mirrored under content/en/; prior-year materials are linked to their canonical upstream repositories.

官方 posit::conf 工作坊材料的主题化总目录，覆盖三届年会。2026 年材料镜像于 content/en/； 往届材料链接到上游权威仓库。

Legend / 图例: 🟢 beginner 入门 · 🟡 intermediate 进阶 · 🔴 advanced 高级 · ⭐ = recommended starting point 推荐起点

Recommended learning paths · 推荐学习路线

  • R 数据科学新手 / R-newcomer: 1.1 → 2.1 → 3.1 → 5.1 → 1.3 → 6.1 → 4.1
  • 现代 R 工程师 / modern R engineer: 2.1 → 1.3 → 1.4 → 3.2 → 8.6 → 2.3
  • AI 工具链 / AI tooling: 2.1 → 8.1 → 8.2 → 8.3 → 8.4 → 8.5 → 6.4
  • 临床制药 / clinical pharma: 1.1 → 1.3 → 9.1 → 9.2 → 9.3 → 7.3
  • Python 双修 / Python track: 2.1 → 4.3 → 5.2 → 5.3 → 6.3 → 7.2

Not curated (backlog) / 未编选（备查）

Kept out of v1 for scope control; still valuable: 2024 quarto-dashboards, quarto-websites, intro-ds-r, tidymodels-intro, tables, dev-ops, databricks, ml-python, wtf, programming-r; 2025 llm (superseded by 2026 llms), ds-workflows-r (superseded by 2026 modern-r-workflow), feat-eng-tune, r-production. 为控制 v1 范围暂不编选；仍有价值，后续按需加入。
